description: Estimate a month of TikTok income in US dollars from Creator Rewards (needs 10,000 followers and 100,000 views in 30 days), sponsored videos (by follower tier) and LIVE gifts. Returns low and high figures and says which Creator Rewards minimums are missing. Rates are public estimates, not guarantees.

average_views.description: Average views per video of one minute or longer.

live_diamonds_per_month.description: Diamonds received from LIVE gifts a month. Default 0.

videos_per_month.description: Videos of one minute or longer posted a month.
